csv_scope_of_work: Fashion Institute of Technology, a community college of art and design, business and technology of the State University of New York is seeking Interior Architectural Design and Related Services for Presidential Housing. The project consists of the full or partial renovation of an existing unit, the Presidential Housing (approx. 4,500 sq., ft. of interior space), which may include reconfiguration of interior spaces, upgrades to systems/structure, and high-quality interior finishes.

relevance_explanation:
